verdict.summary: The dedicated sparq-lws-core coverage lane is wired consistently: selection is fail-closed outside selected mode, the explicit crate subset is registered in the per-commit/dedicated partition, failures feed the existing aggregate verdict and post-merge demoted-lane filer, and the new behavioral tests cover the load-bearing selection, aggregation, ownership, and job-name matching invariants. The unseeded line-coverage floor is disclosed accurately; the lane measures and uploads the result without claiming to enforce a floor that does not yet exist. No correctness, security, or vacuous-test issue was found in the diff.
